text: This report requests Council's authority for the City to assume the services with respect to the development at 3640 St. Clair Avenue East.

City Council on January 31 and February 1, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council assume the services installed at 3640 St. Clair Avenue East and that the City formally assume the roads within the Plan of Subdivision. 2. City Council authorize the Legal Services Division to release the portion of the performance guarantee held with respect to this Plan of Subdivision. 3. City Council direct that an assumption By-law be prepared to assume the public highway and municipal services within the Plan of Subdivision at 3640 St. Clair Avenue East. 4. City Council authorize and direct the City Solicitor to register the assumption By-law in the Registry Office at the expense of the Owner. 5. City Council authorize the City Clerk and the Treasurer to sign any release or other documentation necessary to give effect to City Council's decision. 6.
